_comment: Per-test kept-red expectation manifest (required since #1806 r11 — the runner fails loud when a declared proof lacks it). The declared test MUST fail with an AssertionError on correct code.

expectedRed.testName: two different resetKeys arrays with colliding signatures both reset to page 0
expectedRed.why: On correct code the signature is collision-free: the hook detects the genuine resetKeys change and returns 0 on the first change render, so `expect(consumer.renders[1]).toBe(0)` fails with an AssertionError (the buggy signature clamps back to 1). If this test passes, the signature-collision bug is fixed or the proof cannot measure it.
